title: Hired Gun
personality:
A foundry kid who swept brass casings off Malgrave's war-foundry floors. A siege engine took her arm in the Hollowing, and the gatling she bolted to her shoulder is her right arm now.
The Skylands' most famous gun-for-hire, she keeps a tally mark for every bounty she cashed. Her loyalty is technically for sale, but she sticks with the crew.

lines.dash: Skid or slide, and keep shooting.
lines.lmb: Full-auto rifle. Dazed foes take {resource.rattle_k%}% more.
lines.rmb: Fire the charge from your cannon; its blast Dazes.
lines.e: Stand still, then fire a beam through walls.
lines.x: Call a burning shell down on the cursor.
lines.passive: Knock a Hunter down and Slipstep comes back.

fantasy: The ember-rifle skirmisher. Bounces a spiked charge off the wall so its blast throws a foe back into her rifle, slides around while still shooting, and finishes with one long needle of light.
silhouette: the long scarf streaming behind, the bandolier of spiked charges across the chest and the long-shrouded rifle

card.loop: Mid-range rifleman: Daze a foe with the grenade's cone, then shred them while it lasts.
card.dash: Slipstep: tap to skid, hold to slide further; you can shoot the whole time and it goes where you move, not where you aim.
card.passive: Hot Streak: knocking a hunter down gives Slipstep back. An ability that lands gives you a little lifesteal for a few seconds.
card.rmb: Burr Charge: tap to fire it from your arm-cannon along your aim. A direct hit hurts and Dazes the foe. Where it meets a wall or the ground it blasts a cone back at you, hurting and Dazing everyone in it.
card.e: Longneedle: stand still {tip.e.secs_1}s while the line narrows, then fire a long beam through walls and everything in it.
card.x: Cinderfall (ultimate, level 6): a shell lands at your cursor {x.delay}s after the tap, hardest in the centre, and leaves a burning, slowing patch. Everyone can see where it will fall.

weapons.quill_rifle: Full-auto rifle out to full range. Long strings lose punch; Dazed foes take {resource.rattle_k%}% more (big gold numbers).

passive.name: Hot Streak
passive.desc: Knocking a hunter down gives Slipstep back at once. Each ability that lands (a Burr Charge blast, Longneedle) lights Fever for {resource.wait}s, one flat level however many foes it hits: while it burns your damage heals you for {resource.vamp%}%, rifle included. Your rifle does {resource.rattle_k%}% more to a Dazed foe (the numbers turn big and gold), and a string on a Dazed foe doesn't lose its punch.

dash.name: Slipstep
dash.desc: Tap: a {dash.roll}m skid that bleeds off over {dash.roll_t}s, the way you're moving (not where you aim). Hold: a {dash.slide}m low slide that takes {dash.hold_cost%}% longer to come back, with no refund for letting go early. You keep shooting through either, and the body keeps aiming. A knock gives it back. In the air a tap slides {tip.dash.n_1}/{tip.dash.n_2} of the full hold's distance ({tip.dash.metres_1}m) and still spends a charge.

variants.tap: Tap RMB: it fires from the launcher on her arm-cannon on the press. The charge flies {rmb.burr.range}m along your aim, past the cursor, and goes off on the first foe it strikes: {rmb.burr.hit_dmg} damage and Dazed {rmb.burr.cone_rattle}s.
variants.full: Where it hits a wall, or the ground at the end of the lane, it sticks and a {rmb.burr.cone_len}m, {rmb.burr.cone_deg}° cone shows back toward you for {rmb.burr.fuse}s. Then it blasts: {rmb.burr.cone_dmg} damage, a big shove along the cone, Dazed {rmb.burr.cone_rattle}s. A hunter shoved into more terrain is stunned {rmb.burr.wall_stun}s and Dazed {rmb.burr.wall_daze}s longer.

e.name: Longneedle
e.desc: Stand still and charge for {e.charge}s: a wide line out to {e.range}m narrows to a thin core. The line locks to where you pressed and turns toward your aim at {e.turn_deg_s} degrees a second at most, so a flick can't drag it; your view pulls out along it the further you aim, not at all inside {e.view_near_m}m. Then a heavy beam, {tip.e.metres_1}m wide, fires through cover and everything in its line: {e.dmg} damage, {e.rattle_k%}% more on a Dazed foe, and a Dazed hunter hit is Skewered. The recoil shoves you back a step. Hitting a hunter takes {e.rattle_k%}% off its cooldown ({e.shave_rank3%}% per hunter hit at rank {tip.e.n_1}).

x.name: Cinderfall
x.desc: Tap: fire a shell straight up. It comes down {x.delay}s later exactly where your cursor was (up to {x.range}m), and everyone sees its {x.radius}m disc fill until it lands. The impact deals {x.dmg} to everyone on the disc, {x.core_k%}% more in the hot centre. Then the patch burns for {x.zone_t}s: {x.tick_dmg} every {x.tick}s and a {x.slow%}% slow to anyone standing in it. You move and shoot freely the whole time. Landing the impact on an enemy hunter fills your Boki bond; the burn does not.

rank3.sec: resets when you knock a hunter
rank3.dash: a burst of speed for {tip.dash.secs_1}s when a slide ends
rank3.kin: every hunter hit takes {e.shave_rank3%}% off the cooldown

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {cd3.sec}s; it resets when you knock a hunter.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd3.dash}s; +{tip.dash.pct_1%}% speed for {tip.dash.secs_1}s when a slide ends.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: damage +{dmg3.kin%}%; every hunter hit takes {e.shave_rank3%}% off the cooldown ({e.rattle_k%}% once at ranks {e.self_slow} and {tip.e.n_2}).

tells.half: a lit Fever pip over the bar while the lifesteal runs
tells.full: the same lit pip and a heat shimmer
tells.dash_spent: an ember afterimage and faint skid streaks
